# RestartDevice (command)

COMMON RestartDevice. Reboots the target device: after the ack, the device stops feeding its own watchdog, which resets the chip after watchdog_ms.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** docs/ground-upgrade-path.md "0x0B Reboot Chip" (m1400 handler 0x5124, firmware-side decode of the payload layout and the mode-byte error case) + real-hardware confirmation 2026-10-24 against the ground RC (USB-serial device re-enumerated, DUML sequence counter reset to 0, right when sent). docs/data/apk-dynamic-cmdset-ids.tsv confirms cmdset 0x00/cmdid 0x0b is COMMON/RestartDevice generically, not RC-specific.

## Fields

| name | offset | kind | role/default/valid | confidence | doc |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| reserved | 0 | u8 | const=0 | V | always 0 (m1400 handler 0x5124 byte0, unused by that handler). |
| mode | 1 | u8 | default=1, valid=[0, 1] | V | must be 0 or 1, else the device replies error 0xE3 (m1400 handler 0x5124). Meaning of 0 vs 1 beyond "valid" not decoded. |
| watchdog_ms | 2 | u32 | default=1000 | I | ms until the stopped watchdog resets the chip. 1000ms confirmed working against the ground RC 2026-10-24, not measured as a minimum. |
